# pltr orchestration

Builds, jobs and schedules (Foundry orchestration API).

Everything is addressed by RID: builds (ri.foundry.main.build.<id>), jobs (ri.foundry.main.job.<id>) and schedules (ri.scheduler.main.schedule.<id>). Commands labeled [beta] call beta Foundry endpoints.

Examples:

        # Start a build of a dataset (RID or path) and follow it
        pltr orchestration builds create --dataset /Space/Project/sales
        pltr orchestration builds get <BUILD_RID>
        pltr orchestration builds jobs <BUILD_RID>
        # Find recent failed builds
        pltr orchestration builds search --status FAILED --order-by STARTED_TIME
        # Inspect a schedule and its runs, or run it now
        pltr orchestration schedules get <SCHEDULE_RID>
        pltr orchestration schedules runs <SCHEDULE_RID>
        pltr orchestration schedules run <SCHEDULE_RID>

17 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

## pltr orchestration builds

Start, inspect and cancel builds

### pltr orchestration builds cancel

Cancel a build's unfinished jobs.

`pltr orchestration builds cancel BUILD_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `BUILD_RID`: Build RID (ri.foundry.main.build.<id>).
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `orchestration.Build.cancel`

### pltr orchestration builds create

Start a build of datasets (or other build targets).

`pltr orchestration builds create [TARGET] [OPTIONS]`

- `TARGET` (optional): What to build, as JSON or @file.json, with Compass paths allowed in its RID fields (see the examples below); leave it out when you use --dataset.
- `--dataset` RID|PATH (repeatable): Dataset RID to build, instead of TARGET (repeat for several): builds exactly these datasets, like a manual target.
- `--branch` TEXT: Branch to build on.
- `--fallback-branch` TEXT (repeatable): Branch to read an input from when it doesn't exist on --branch (repeat for several, in order).
- `--force`: Build even if the outputs are already up to date.
- `--abort-on-failure`: Stop the other jobs when one job fails.
- `--notifications`, `--no-notifications` (default: True): Send build notifications.
- `--retry-count` INTEGER: Number of retry attempts for failed jobs.
- `--wait`: Wait until the work finishes and print its final state: exit 8 if it failed, 9 if --timeout passed first (it keeps running).
- `--timeout` NUMBER (default: 600): Seconds to wait before giving up (exit 9; the work keeps running).
- SDK: `orchestration.Build.create`, `orchestration.Build.get`, `orchestration.Build.jobs`

### pltr orchestration builds get-batch

`pltr orchestration builds get-batch BUILD_RIDS... [OPTIONS]`

### pltr orchestration builds search

[beta] Search builds by status, branch, creator and start/finish time.

`pltr orchestration builds search [OPTIONS]`

- `--where` TEXT: Filter as JSON or @file.json in the API's SearchBuildsFilter shape (eq, gte, lt, and, or, not; see below).
- `--status` RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED|CANCELED: Only builds with this status.
- `--branch` TEXT: Only builds on this branch.
- `--created-by` TEXT: Only builds started by this user ID.
- `--started-after` TEXT: Only builds started at or after this time (ISO-8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2024-01-31T00:00:00Z).
- `--started-before` TEXT: Only builds started before this time.
- `--finished-after` TEXT: Only builds finished at or after this time.
- `--finished-before` TEXT: Only builds finished before this time.
- `--order-by` TEXT (repeatable): Sort by STARTED_TIME or FINISHED_TIME, optionally with :ASC or :DESC (default DESC); repeat to sort by both.
- beta · paged · SDK: `orchestration.Build.search`

### pltr orchestration builds wait

Wait for a build to finish, then print it.

`pltr orchestration builds wait BUILD_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `BUILD_RID`: Build RID (ri.foundry.main.build.<id>).
- `--timeout` NUMBER (default: 600): Seconds to wait before giving up (exit 9; the work keeps running).
- SDK: `orchestration.Build.get`, `orchestration.Build.jobs`

## pltr orchestration schedules

Inspect, run and manage schedules

### pltr orchestration schedules create

[beta] Create a schedule.

`pltr orchestration schedules create ACTION [OPTIONS]`

- `ACTION`: What the schedule builds, as JSON or @file.json in the API's shape (Compass paths work in the target's RID fields), e.g. '{"target": {"type": "manual", "targetRids": ["<dataset RID>"]}...
- `--name` TEXT: Display name of the schedule.
- `--description` TEXT: Description of the schedule.
- `--trigger` TEXT: When the schedule runs, as JSON or @file.json in the API's shape (a datasetRid or mediaSetRid can be a Compass path), e.g. '{"type": "time", "cronExpression": "0 6 * * *", "timeZone": "UTC"}'.
- `--scope-mode` TEXT: Whose permissions the schedule's builds use, as JSON or @file.json (projectRids can be Compass paths): '{"type": "project", "projectRids": ["<project RID>"]}' or '{"type": "user"}'.
- beta · SDK: `orchestration.Schedule.create`

### pltr orchestration schedules delete

Delete a schedule.

`pltr orchestration schedules delete SCHEDULE_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `SCHEDULE_RID`: Schedule RID (ri.scheduler.main.schedule.<id>).
